reasons: CS4246 requires CS3243 or CS3263 as a prerequisite, but neither is in the student's completed list, must-take list, or can be planned before semester 6 due to their own prerequisites (CS2109S/CS2109HS and CS2040 variants) not being fully satisfied or blocked by other constraints in the available slots.

CS3268 requires CS3243 or CS3263 as a prerequisite. Since CS4246 (which requires CS3243/CS3263) is fixed in Sem 6, and CS3268 must follow CS4246, CS3268 would be in Sem 7 or later. However, CS3268 also requires ST2334 (completed) and (ST2131 or (MA2116/MA2116T and ST2132)). The student has ST2334 but lacks ST2131, MA2116, MA2116T, and ST2132. These prerequisites are not in the must-take list and cannot be added as they are not prerequisites for any other must-take course.
CS4278 requires CS3263 or CS3243. Similar to CS4246 and CS3268, the prerequisite CS3243/CS3263 is missing from the student's record and cannot be fulfilled by the remaining must-take courses.
